question: Which mantra, recited a thousandfold, is identified as having the form of the rooster-mantra of the great lord?
premises: A mantra is recited a thousandfold.
It is the great-lord mantra in the form of the rooster-mantra.
inference: The mantra recited a thousandfold is the Maheśa mantra in the form of the Kukkuṭa-mantra.
plain_english: That great-lord mantra, which has the form of the rooster-mantra, when recited a thousandfold—
